# Correctness v1.2: Lineage Levels

## Data lineage levels
- L0_raw_upstream: direct upstream payload with source hash.
- L1_processed_source: T2C processed Voigt with parser manifest / transformation history.
- L2_internal_consistency: processed Voigt + stored Cartesian, no upstream provenance.
- unresolved: fields missing or unrecognised.
